mechanism: Reasoning {{audit}}: Periodically pause object-level work. Evaluate: Am I making progress? Is my approach sound? Am I missing something obvious? Have my assumptions changed? Correct course or continue based on audit results. It triggers a recursive {{reflexion}} cycle where the reasoning process itself becomes the object of critique. The checker {{check}}s the checking process at a {{meta}} level.
failure_modes: Infinite {{meta}}-Regress: Checking the checker that checks the checker, never terminating.
invariants: Pauses object-level work; the {{audit}} does not run alongside it.
The {{check}} is applied to the checking process itself, not only to the object-level work.

parameters.name: recursion_depth
parameters.description: Levels of meta-verification permitted before the audit must return.

parameters.name: consistency_required
parameters.description: Agreement across meta-levels below which the audit reports an unresolved conflict.
